# Security Policy 🛡️

## Supported Versions ✅

Only the latest major version of this project is currently being supported with security updates. 

## Reporting a Vulnerability 🚨

We take the security of our systems seriously. If you discover a vulnerability, we would like to know about it so we can take steps to address it as quickly as possible.

**Please do NOT report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

Instead, please report them directly via email to the project maintainers. You should receive a response within 48 hours. If the issue is confirmed, we will release a patch as soon as possible.
